ownerStatement: Owner approval in session: onboard the JVM languages (java, kotlin, groovy, scala), the web languages (ts/js/vue/svelte), and system languages (c/cpp/rust/go/zig). Java, kotlin, scala, typescript, javascript already carry wave-1 evidence; wave 2 is the eight new languages: groovy, zig, go, rust, c, cpp, vue, svelte. Each language's leg is judged honestly — a language whose analyzer is not ready records a failed/blocked leg, never a claim.
authority: Owner message in the working session: 'we can onboard the jvm languages like java, kotlin, groovy, scala, and the web languages like the ts/js/vue/svelte and then few system languages as well like c/cpp/rust/go/zig'
evidenceRule: The R2 verifier executes exactly this set and nothing else; any language not in this list that attempts a wave leg fails the verifier. A leg's freshness includes the language's OWN analyzer (wave-2 relevance rule): a changed analyzer re-runs the leg.
notes: Fixture packs authored fixture-first under script/m29/wave-fixtures/<lang>/ (main.<ext> + expectations.json). All eight passed S1-S4 at approval time (S4 real-index counts recorded in validation/m29/results/ramp-<lang>.json on execution).
